description: Client-side script for user management interface in OpenCart admin panel, handling form submission, autocomplete fields, checkbox toggling, and AJAX-based pagination and actions.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Handles form submission for filtering users, updates URL and loads user list.

methods.name: autocomplete source functions
methods.description: Fetch autocomplete suggestions for username, name, and email fields via AJAX.

methods.name: select handlers
methods.description: Set selected autocomplete value into input fields.

methods.name: checkbox toggle
methods.description: Toggle checkboxes in table rows when label is clicked.

methods.name: pagination click handlers
methods.description: Handle pagination clicks for user and login sections, loading content via AJAX.

methods.name: authorize button click handler
methods.description: Handle user authorization actions with confirmation, AJAX request, and success/error handling.
